definition: A placement that breaks a hard fact of its house type — a declared stack, bearing continuity, a stated hearth, floor inside no room — or whose facts cannot all hold. No sheet or export draws it; the brief or the parti must change.
basis: build/typefacts.py, the refusal to draw: "a placement that breaks a hard fact of the type is REFUSED, not" drawn, and "the bench shows the conflict set; the brief or the parti is what changes". Its fact titles name "a declared stack over the room it names" and "a stated fire on a wall its massing puts a flue on"; bearing refuses on continuity alone ("THE STATUS IS CONTINUITY'S ALONE"); a proven infeasibility refuses because "the prover showed the declared facts cannot all hold". build/export_dxf.py: a CAD file "is refused here exactly as the sheet is".
sense: a placement the corpus will not draw
more: A fact that could not be judged never refuses: only a fact measured and found not to hold, or a proven conflict, does. The refused placement stays on the record, because it is the conflict's own explanation; no surface a person reads draws it.
